callflowSimulator.title: Callflow Simulator
callflowSimulator.pickSomething: Pick a number or callflow on the left to see where its calls go.
callflowSimulator.loadFailed: Could not load this account's callflows.
callflowSimulator.simHint: Pick when the call comes in. The path it takes lights up — press keys on a menu's keypad to choose.
callflowSimulator.simNeedsStart: Pick one number or callflow — or click a number on the map — to simulate a call to it.
callflowSimulator.nowHint: Set the date and time to right now
callflowSimulator.currentOnly: Hide routes this call doesn't take
callflowSimulator.liveHint: Uses each phone's real status right now: users whose phones are all offline don't answer.
callflowSimulator.noAudio: Audio playback is not available here.
callflowSimulator.exportHint: Opens a print view — choose "Save as PDF" to share it with someone who can't log in.
callflowSimulator.fam_logic_d: time of day, jumps, caller ID
callflowSimulator.callerIdHint: Optional. Used by caller-ID checks, and sent to a pivot test.
callflowSimulator.lockedHint: The route this call took at that moment. Press keys on a menu's keypad to see what each choice would have done.
callflowSimulator.switchesHint: Time rules that are switched by hand or forced on/off. Flip one to see where calls would go — nothing is changed in Kazoo.
callflowSimulator.switchesLockedHint: Shown as they are now; they may have been switched differently when the call came in.
callflowSimulator.pivotWarnTitle: Before you send a test request
callflowSimulator.pivotWarnData: Kazoo sends the call's details (caller ID, number dialled, call ID, account, digits collected, variables) with every pivot request. This test sends none of that — unless you tick "Send call data", and then only the values below: made up, or worked out from the route.
callflowSimulator.pivotWarnServer: A server that expects call details may answer with an error, or treat the test as a real call (log it, send a message, change data). Test only servers you are responsible for; you do so at your own risk.
callflowSimulator.pivotWarnIp: The request comes from this browser, from your own IP address — not from Kazoo. A firewall or allow-list on the server may block it.
callflowSimulator.pivotWarnCors: The server must allow requests from a web page (CORS), or the browser can't read its reply. If so, paste the reply below instead.
callflowSimulator.pivotWarnMixed: This URL is http:// and this page is https://, so the browser will block the request. Paste the reply below instead.
callflowSimulator.pivotFromRouteHint: What earlier steps would have collected or set by the time the call reaches this pivot. Type the digits a caller would enter.
callflowSimulator.pivotHttpError: The server answered with an error.
callflowSimulator.pivotBadJson: The reply is not valid JSON
callflowSimulator.pivotBadXml: The reply is not valid XML:
callflowSimulator.pivotAgree: I understand. Send the test request.
callflowSimulator.pivotPaste: Or paste a reply from the server
callflowSimulator.pivotErrNet: No reply the browser could read. The server may be down or slow, may be blocking your IP address, or may not allow requests from a web page (CORS). You can paste a reply instead.
callflowSimulator.pivotErrTimeout: The server did not answer in time. In a real call Kazoo would give up too and take the "If the server fails" branch.
callflowSimulator.pivotFailBranch: Kazoo would treat this as a failed pivot and take the "If the server fails" branch.
callflowSimulator.pivotDrawn: The reply is drawn on the map after the pivot step, and the simulation follows it.
callflowSimulator.pivotNotFlow: This is not a Kazoo callflow. Kazoo expects { "module": …, "data": …, "children": … }.
callflowSimulator.pivotWholeDoc: This is a whole callflow document. Kazoo expects only its "flow" part ({ "module": …, "data": …, "children": … }).
